title: Find shortest unweighted distances by arrival layers
prompt: Return an int distance for each vertex from source, using -1 for unreachable vertices. Directed adjacency lists have <=100 vertices. Reject an invalid source or any invalid neighbor with invalid_argument, even in an unreachable component. Do not mutate the graph.

tests.label: Layers
tests.hint: A new neighbor is one layer farther.

tests.label: Cycle
tests.hint: Mark on enqueue to avoid revisiting.

tests.label: Bad unreachable edge
tests.hint: Validate the entire graph, not only reached edges.

tests.label: Self loop
tests.hint: The source already has a distance.

hints: A FIFO queue preserves layers of increasing distance.
explanation: The first visit is shortest because every edge adds one step and the queue handles earlier layers first. The starter sample prints 0 -1 -1 -1 because it never explores neighbors. DFS finds reachability but not these shortest distances; weighted edges need a different algorithm. Keep validation separate from traversal so malformed hidden components cannot enter accepted state.
